newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska cattle markets near midday Monday were quiet, with no sales reported amid light inquiry, market sources said.
Bids were $108.00 to $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, with owners asking $112.00 to $114.00. Last test of the market was Thursday at $112.00 on about 3,000 head.
"If $112.00 (bids) were to come around, they could own a lot of cattle," one market source said.
On a live basis, bids were expected to surface at $65.00 to $66.00. Owners were asking $68.00. This week's showlist was estimated near 88,000 head, up 5,000 from last week.
